name: PNG GIF Slideshow

props.text: Choose a folder with PNG/GIF images
PNG/GIF first frame only. Up to 500 files / 5000 entries. 2 MiB, 4096 pixels per side, 8 million pixels per image.

startup:
# Nothing is read until the user selects a folder.
self.slide_files = []
self.slide_index = 0
self.slide_photo = None
self.slide_job = None
self.slide_playing = False
self.slide_generation = 0
self.IntervalScale.set(3)
self.Form1.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", lambda: slide_close(self))
self.Form1.deiconify()
